data.name: Shivdas
data.gender_notes: Shivdas is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The name Shivdas is derived from the name Shiva, which means 'The Auspicious One' or 'The God of Destruction'. The 'das' part of the name means 'gift' or 'servant'. So, Shivdas can be translated to 'Shiva's Gift' or 'Shiva's Servant'. The name Shivdas carries the meaning “Shiva's gift” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Sanskrit, Hindi. Parents who choose Shivdas usually hope their child will grow to embody shiva's gift and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Shivdas is a name of great spiritual significance in Hinduism. It is believed that the name Shivdas connects the bearer to the divine energy of Lord Shiva, who is known as the destroyer of all negative energies and the giver of blessings. The name also symbolizes strength, power, and protection.
data.etymology: Shivdas belongs to the Hindu linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Shiva's gift.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Shivdas total 1, giving a life-path number of 1. Number 1 is linked with Sun and with the qualities of leadership, independence and initiative.

data.cultural_impact: The name Shivdas has deep cultural roots and is an homage to one of the most revered deities in Hinduism - Lord Shiva. Lord Shiva is known as the God of Destruction, and is also the patron of arts, knowledge, and yoga. He is depicted as having a third eye, which is believed to represent wisdom and divine vision. The name Shivdas reflects the deep reverence and respect the bearer has for Lord Shiva and signifies a connection to ancient Indian traditions, customs, and heritage.
data.spiritual_significance: The name Shivdas holds a profound spiritual significance as it symbolizes one's devotion and dedication to Lord Shiva. The 'servant' part of the name emphasizes the bearer's willingness to serve and follow the divine path laid out by Lord Shiva. The 'gift' part of the name signifies the grace and blessings the bearer receives from Lord Shiva. On a deeper level, Shivdas can also symbolize the belief that true inner peace and contentment can only be attained by serving and surrendering to the divine. Ultimately, the name Shivdas is a constant reminder of the interconnectedness of all things and the importance of living a life grounded in faith and devotion.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Shivdas: Servant of Lord Shiva. Embodiment of devotion and dedication to the divine force of destruction and regeneration.
